description.value: Chipotle is a fast-casual Mexican-inspired chain offering fully customizable burritos, burrito bowls, tacos, and salads assembled from fresh, daily-prepared ingredients. This Burnaby location is a sit-down and takeout option with no drive-through, situated in what appears to be a commercial retail complex on Grande Promenade. Cyclists will find it a filling stop with a broad menu that supports high-calorie refuelling.
